records.text:
$defLog = 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational'
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$case = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ('Documents\book2-ch07-' + $stamp)
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $case) { throw 'Export directory already exists' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $case -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
wevtutil epl Security "$case\Security.evtx" /ow:false
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Security export failed' }
wevtutil epl System "$case\System.evtx" /ow:false
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'System export failed' }
wevtutil epl "$defLog" "$case\Defender.evtx" /ow:false
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Defender export failed' }
$files = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $case -File | Select-Object Name,Length
$hashes = Get-FileHash -LiteralPath "$case\Security.evtx","$case\System.evtx","$case\Defender.evtx" -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Path,Hash
$ev = Get-WinEvent -Path "$case\Defender.evtx" -FilterXPath '*[System[EventRecordID=47]]' | Select-Object Id,RecordId,TimeCreated
[pscustomobject]@{Directory=$case;Files=$files;Hashes=$hashes;ReadCopy=$ev} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
